newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle lightly trade steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle lightly trade steady - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested, but few sales steady in Nebraska, USDA said.
Buyer inquiry fair. Seller interest light. Showlists well depleted. Weekly volume 100,000. Sales Confirmed: 800 Last Week: 200 Last Year: 600 Week To Date: Sm Pd Lst Wk: Sm Pd Lst Yr:
Live basis sales: Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
Slaughter Steers: Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs: 104.00.
Slaughter Heifers: Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1150 lbs: 104.00.
